reason: It's a brand new store with zero Google reviews, and I don't walk into a place until I've read what other girls say about it. The prices sound fine, but I'd wait a month or two and see the ratings and photos first.
objection: No reviews yet, and from the description I can't tell if the thobes and abayas are actually my style or just the same plain, very traditional pieces I can already find on Hillcroft.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a solid Google Maps rating with real customer photos of the pieces, especially ones that look modern and not too plain.
